name: Eddie Hall
features: fair skin, dark hair parted and slicked flat, light blue eyes, broad open face, strong chin, solid athletic build, cheerful determined expression
bio: Edward Ramsden Hall, Yorkshire textile money and a bobsleigher for Britain at the 1928 Winter Olympics, ran every Ards Tourist Trophy from 1928 to 1936 and finished second three years running, each time setting the fastest race pace and each time beaten only by the handicap. In 1950 he drove the whole 24 Hours of Le Mans single-handed in a 4¼-litre Bentley to finish eighth, the only man ever to do it.
